cohort: The study included 200 ASA grade II patients aged 18 to 45 years who underwent elective or emergency caesarean section.
finding: Intrathecal fentanyl (25µg) reduced the incidence (1% vs 5%) and severity of post-dural puncture headache (PDPH) in caesarean delivery compared to the control group, though these reductions were not statistically significant.
